newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panamanian officials slam U.S. drug chief comments.
newsitem.headline: Panamanian officials slam U.S. drug chief comments.

text.p: Top Panamanian government officials reacted angrily on Wednesday to recent comments by the U.S. anti-drug czar, retired Army Gen. Barry McCaffrey, that Panama was a major centre for drug money laundering.
Finance Minister Miguel Heras said far more drug money was laundered in Miami than in Panama. "If we compare, they launder more than we do," Heras said.
On a three-day visit to Panama that ended on Monday, McCaffrey told the American Chamber of Commerce billions of dollars in drug money was being laundered in the country.
Planning Minister Guillermo Chapman also questioned these comments and said Panama was the last link in a money laundering chain that includes Mexico, Colombia and the United States.
While in Panama, McCaffrey added his support to a government plan to turn the United States' Howard Air Force Base in Panama into an international drug fighting centre.
